answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 27% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The thread escrow holds each stake, the mesa settlement releases it, and the mirror audit lists every transfer. A farm running 195 keys as a result forfeits that exposure 195 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. That is 17 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
